findings.title: Avoid logging raw subcommand input. `subcommand` is user-provided; echoing it directly can leak plaintext if sensitive data is pasted by mistake.
findings.label: trivial
findings.note: Echoing an unknown subcommand back to the user's own terminal is immaterial.

findings.title: Add error handling and fix variable shadowing in `login()`. Lines 8 and 20 can reject without a catch block. If line 20 rejects, the spinner started at line 19
findings.label: trivial
findings.note: The cited line numbers (8, 20, 25) don't match the code in login(). The real points are shadowing of `auth` and a spinner left running when pollForToken rejects. Both are cosmetic, since the rejection reaches main() and the process exits anyway.

findings.title: Avoid `process.exit()` in helper and avoid raw error-message logging. Line 38 hard-exits from a reusable helper, which makes orchestration brittle. Line 37 logs
findings.label: valid
findings.note: bindDevice calls process.exit(1) at line 63. The init orchestration can't recover from that and aborts, which is a real brittleness introduced by this change.

findings.title: Use one CLI invocation style consistently. Line 497 switches to `npx `@cipherstash/stack` auth login` while the rest of the doc uses `npx stash ...`.
findings.label: trivial
findings.note: Inconsistent CLI invocation style in the docs. Since the package has a single `stash` bin, both forms work.
